verdict.rationale: Ramp ships an official, account-scoped MCP server for ChatGPT, Claude and other assistants so users can "query Ramp data and take actions with natural language." Documented example prompts include "Lock my card — I can't find it" and "Show me our top software vendors by spend this quarter," and the server covers reads, approvals, edits and policy Q&A. In-product natural-language intake also exists ("Tell Ramp what you need to buy," "Describe what vendor you're looking for," policy questions via SMS/Slack). Missing for 10: bill approvals are not yet available via MCP, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation beyond the probe confirming the MCP server is documented.
